topline.text: Another quiet 24-48 hours nationally - no new DfE, Ofsted, safeguarding, SEND or funding announcement cleared the corroboration bar, so today's edition stays short rather than padded.

Anti-Bullying Week 2026 launches today under the Anti-Bullying Alliance's 'Break the Silence' theme, opening with Odd Socks Day; the Alliance says many bullied children still don't tell a trusted adult.
topline.action: Worth a line in today's briefing or assembly - the theme speaks directly to why pupils with SEND or EHCPs can be slower to disclose.

topline.text: Reminder: DfE's call for evidence on exclusion reform (internal suspension, reintegration partnerships, schoolwork during suspension) closes in 3 days, on 19 November.

diary.text: Anti-Bullying Week 2026 - 'Break the Silence' theme; Odd Socks Day opens the week today.
DfE's call for evidence on school exclusion reform (internal suspension, reintegration partnerships, managed moves) closes - 3 days away.
DfE due to publish autumn 2025/26 suspensions and permanent exclusions statistics for England.

items.lede: Anti-Bullying Week 2026 opens today with 'Break the Silence' theme.
items.body: The Anti-Bullying Alliance's annual week runs 16-20 November, its theme shaped by input from over 200 children and young people, opening with Odd Socks Day. Alliance director Martha Boateng says many children experiencing bullying still don't tell a trusted adult; NCB cites more than one in five children reporting being bullied each year (exact disclosure-rate figure not given in the source - flagged as approximate).
items.action: Worth flagging to pastoral leads given the theme's direct relevance to disclosure barriers for SEND and vulnerable pupils.

items.lede: DfE's exclusion reform call for evidence enters its final week.
items.body: The call for evidence on behaviour management - covering internal suspension, reintegration support partnerships and schoolwork provision during the first five days of a suspension or permanent exclusion - closes 19 November. It feeds the 'Every Child Achieving and Thriving' white paper's proposed time-limited internal suspension framework.
items.action: Last chance for any Sheffield-side input before Wednesday's deadline.

box.text: children in England report being bullied each year, NCB says ahead of Anti-Bullying Week - many never tell a trusted adult (precise disclosure rate not published).
